title: Answers grounded in current repository documentation

questions.text: What is the default dev base URL for the Client API (sessions, /api/a2a)?

answer.text: http://localhost:5173 — same origin as the Vite web app; paths under /api/a2a/*.

sources.section: Unified manual path — Create a new session

questions.text: Which TCP port does the A2A Server use by default?

answer.text: 3000 (default PORT).

questions.text: Which port is AI Integration (proxy to Local LLM upstream)?
Which port is the Local LLM upstream in the default stack diagram?
On Windows, how should you restart the live coordinated stack?

answer.text: Run start-all.bat from the repository root only — not per-package npm run dev inside a2a-server, a2a-client, or ai-integration.

questions.text: Required length for ENCRYPTION_KEY in tests?

answer.text: Exactly 32 characters.

questions.text: Which database name should tests use (not production server DB)?

answer.text: a2a_test (not a2a_server).

questions.text: Does a2a-server persist multi-step client sessions, or what does invoke do instead?

answer.text: No client session persistence on the server. a2a-server is stateless: it accepts POST /api/v1/invoke, creates an async request row (ticket) keyed by promiseId, returns that promise immediately, and exposes terminal execute/context only via polling (GET /api/v1/requests/{promiseId}/result). Folder-based session history lives in the Client API (a2a-client/storage/sessions/).

questions.text: What does POST /api/v1/invoke return before polling completes?

answer.text: A promiseId (async); terminal execute/context arrive from GET /api/v1/requests/{promiseId}/result (or Client API GET …/async), not inline on the POST.

questions.text: How many action-type keys may appear in one execute or one result object?

answer.text: Exactly one — action-key shape: a single key per execute/result object (e.g. execute.script, result.read-file).

questions.text: What prefix does the stateless server use for context.session_id?

answer.text: srv_sess_* — server-assigned; the client does not forward its storage sessionId as the server session token.

questions.text: Before proxying to the server, does the Client API send projectId or storage sessionId?

answer.text: No — those are stripped so the stateless server does not receive client storage/session project identifiers.

questions.text: Where should schema / execute-shape issues be reproduced first?

answer.text: tests/direct-tests (see tests/direct-tests/README.md) before session e2e or full sims.

sources.section: Critical Rules — Schema Debugging Entry Point

questions.text: What HTTP surface is the normative manual path for driving sessions after start-all?

answer.text: Client API (POST /api/a2a/sessions, /next, GET /async) — not POST /api/v1/invoke alone.

sources.section: What the operator does not do

questions.text: How is the Router defined in this repo?

answer.text: Keyword-based routing (dialog / agent / task-decomposition and registry actions when keywords match).

questions.text: What is Web DTO?

answer.text: Client-sanitized execute (form only, not raw tool calls in the client-facing projection).

questions.text: For the web UI, should the browser call http://localhost:3000 directly?

answer.text: No — same origin as Vite; use /api/a2a/* (Client API). The Client API forwards to a2a-server under the hood.

questions.text: What happens to GET /api/a2a/sessions/:id?includeContext=1 when NODE_ENV=production?

answer.text: 403 on both Vite Client API and standalone SDK (per ADR-0028 operator notes).

questions.text: Minimum length for JWT_SECRET (with ENCRYPTION_KEY for auth issues)?

answer.text: 32+ characters (together with 32-char ENCRYPTION_KEY) — see AGENTS debugging / Common Issues.

questions.text: May operators disable PROMISE_DAEMON_ONLY or add a sync invoke shortcut to unstick work?

answer.text: No — async end-to-end; use the promise-queue daemon or POST …/promise/<id>/execute; do not disable the queue as a workaround.

questions.text: Should polling GET /api/v1/requests/{id}/result or GET …/async use a max-attempt wall cap?

answer.text: Normatively no arbitrary cap — wait until status is terminal (completed/failed/cancelled) or async is settled; only backoff between polls.

questions.text: Which port does the standalone SDK Client API typically use (secondary to Vite 5173)?

answer.text: Often 3001 (or another PORT) — same contract as Vite /api/a2a; primary web path remains 5173 same-origin.

questions.text: Does POST …/sessions/{id}/next echo promiseId in the ack?

answer.text: No — use asyncPending then GET …/async; promiseId is not echoed on the next ack.

questions.text: What is the canonical dev value for A2A_SERVER_URL?

answer.text: http://localhost:3000 (base origin for /api/v1/invoke).

questions.text: What is the canonical dev value for AI_HUB_URL (ai-integration)?

answer.text: http://localhost:11434.

questions.text: Is SKIP_AUTH=1 acceptable in production?

answer.text: No — dev/test bypass only; production should require real auth (see ENV-MATRIX baseline rules).

questions.text: When A2A_GRAY_ROOM_ENABLED is unset, is Gray Room on or off?

answer.text: On by default (unset or 1); set 0/false/off to skip interrupt expansion.

questions.text: Which files are the authoritative simulation contract per step?

answer.text: request.json and response.json (plus received.json where applicable) under simulations/sync/ and simulations/async/.

questions.text: What does received.json represent in the simulation pipeline?

answer.text: Client API → Web: sanitized execute (Web DTO) after projection — what the UI should render.

questions.text: Are Gray Room and Gray alert the same concept?

answer.text: No — Rooms are runtime pipeline phases; colored alerts are triage labels (where to look first).

questions.text: What does start-all.bat start on Windows related to PROMISE_DAEMON_ONLY?

answer.text: A promise-queue-daemon window that polls the hub on 11434 and POST /promise/<id>/execute when PROMISE_DAEMON_ONLY is on (default).

questions.text: Default REQUEST_RETRY_DELAY_MS (dialog deferral before re-queue is eligible)?
Default REQUEST_MAX_RETRIES per promiseId (dialog deferral)?
In the triangle workflow, what do vertices A, B, and C represent?

answer.text: A = Client API (sessions, /next, /async, storage); B = a2a-server (invoke/transforms); C = ai-integration (LLM path). Local LLM upstream sits behind C.

questions.text: Triangle loop step C1: which health URL and OK signal?

answer.text: GET ${AI_HUB_URL}/health — default host http://localhost:11434 — OK means HTTP 200.

questions.text: Does the browser need the A2A promiseId to poll session progress?

answer.text: No — transport ids stay server-side; the Client API resolves in-flight work (use GET …/async).

questions.text: In the normal Web DTO from GET /sessions/:id, is context included?

answer.text: No — context is omitted unless ?includeContext=1 (debug).

questions.text: What does GET /api/a2a/sessions/{id}/async expose about promiseId?

answer.text: Preferred web poll; response body has no promiseId — the id stays server-internal.

questions.text: When does the Client API treat the prior step as “has choices” for /next?

answer.text: When execute.form.choices is a non-empty array OR execute.form.meta.routerChoices is set (router parity).

questions.text: Are transformSchema required validation failures deferred like hub-down dialog errors?

answer.text: No — they stay terminal (failed immediately); not treated as deferrable infra retry.

questions.text: Per PROTOCOL.md action-key examples, is { "result": { "content": "..." } } valid?

answer.text: No — wrong shape; result must use the action-key wrapper (e.g. a named action key), not a bare content field.
